title: Hover Interactions
summary: Hover is a pointer enhancement that previews or reveals; it must never be the only way to reach an action or content.

MUST.text: Provide equivalent focus, click and touch behavior for every hover-revealed action.
Keep hover content dismissible and available long enough to reach and read (WCAG 1.4.13).
Do not move or obscure existing content when hover content appears.

SHOULD.text: Show affordance feedback (color, cursor) within 100 ms on hover.
Delay hiding hover content by 300–500 ms after the pointer leaves to avoid accidental dismissal.

AVOID.text: Do not reveal essential controls only on hover.
Do not trigger navigation or destructive actions on hover alone.

DECIDE.decision: Also expose on focus and click

EXAMPLE.good: "Row menu appears on hover and focus, stays open while pointer is over it, and is reachable by tap."
EXAMPLE.bad: "Delete action appears only on hover with no keyboard or touch path."

FAILURE_MODES: Hover-only controls are unreachable for keyboard and touch users.
Hover content that disappears immediately causes repeated re-triggering.
Hover-triggered navigation causes accidental page changes.
